admin.market.intro: Every ticker and FX pair ever used accumulates daily prices, dividends and splits. Prices are stored unadjusted; total return is computed here and checked against the source.
admin.sources.intro: US statements come straight from the SEC's official XBRL data: every document is kept as fetched, every filed number accumulates, and restatements keep both values.
admin.sources.secContactHelp: The SEC requires an organisation name and e-mail on every request, e.g. “Example Research admin@example.com”. It is only sent to the SEC.
admin.sources.needContact: Set the SEC contact before fetching statement data.
admin.sources.synced: {ticker} {name}: {filings} new filings and {facts} new numbers, {total} in total.
admin.sources.unchanged: {ticker} {name}: no change at the SEC ({total} numbers).
admin.sources.noXbrl: This company has no XBRL financial data.
theme.label: Theme
theme.help: Saved to your account and used on your other devices.
market.note.adjusted_mismatch: The total return computed here differs from the source's adjusted close and needs review. Common causes: the source applies a dividend in the wrong currency (e.g. declared in USD, traded in HKD) or misses a rights issue. The system computes total return itself from unadjusted prices and dividends.
market.note.source_usd_dividend: The source's adjusted close deducts dividends declared in USD as if they were HKD (about 7.8 times too little). The system checked each ex-date and reproduces the source's figures by repeating that mistake; its own total return uses the HKD dividend and is the correct figure.
market.note.no_source_adjusted: The source has no adjusted prices to check against.
